module.label: Omnichannel
module.description: A shared agent workspace for customer conversations across supported channels. The conversation records stay with Voice & Communications; queues and routing stay with Service Desk.

page.title: Omnichannel
page.subtitle: The shared agent inbox for conversations from the enabled channels, with identity evidence, assignment and channel threads.
